metadata.scope_note: Official/public records for architecture-related London planning, transport, regeneration, estate, civic/public-realm, LLDC and OPDC project milestones. NHLE/HAR records were intentionally excluded.
metadata.duplicate_check_scope: Searched tmp/subagents London candidate JSON files plus open-citylog/data-discovery/london JSON files for project names and obvious event titles before selecting rows.
metadata.coordinate_note: Coordinates are approximate WGS84 point centroids for the named site or station unless the source itself provides a measured geometry.

candidates.title: Aberfeldy Estate planning application called in by the Deputy Mayor
candidates.observed_change: The GLA public-hearing page records that the Aberfeldy Estate application in Poplar was called in on 2023-05-02, transferring decision responsibility from Tower Hamlets to the Mayor/GLA process; the page also records a final decision notice issued on 2024-06-03.
candidates.location: Aberfeldy Estate, Poplar, London Borough of Tower Hamlets
candidates.publisher: Greater London Authority / London City Hall
candidates.license_terms: London City Hall website terms; cite factual metadata and source URL, do not redistribute page text/media without reuse review.
candidates.limitations: Administrative planning milestone, not evidence of demolition, construction start, completion, occupation, or estate outcomes. Coordinates are approximate estate centroid.
candidates.duplicate_check_note: No matching Aberfeldy Estate candidate found in searched London tmp/open-citylog files.

candidates.location: Stratford Waterfront / East Bank, Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park

candidates.duplicate_check_note: open-citylog source catalog has East Bank source pages, but no matching event candidate for this June 2019 planning-permission milestone was found.
